faq_heading: West Vancouver golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a West Vancouver golf course home cost?
faq.a: The 128 flagged detached homes that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $3,062,500, and the middle half sold between $2,407,500 and $4,503,750. All 351 West Vancouver detached sales had a median of $2,845,000.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in West Vancouver?
faq.a: On the sold figures, a detached home whose Paragon Site Influences field lists Golf Course Nearby or Golf Course Dev. The listing agent enters it, so it covers homes near a course as well as on one. The live search above uses the word golf in the listing remarks instead.

faq.q: How fast do West Vancouver golf course homes sell?
faq.a: 32 days at a median, closing at 92.9% of the last list price. All West Vancouver detached homes took 33 days and closed at 93.0%.

faq.q: Which West Vancouver neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: British Properties had 29 flagged sales, Dundarave 12, and Eagle Harbour and Gleneagles 10 each, between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026.

This search lists detached houses for sale in West Vancouver whose listing remarks mention golf. That is a word search, so it also finds houses that name a course in the description without flagging it, and it can miss a house whose agent left the word out.

West Vancouver had 351 detached sales between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, and 128 of them (36%) carried a golf flag in Paragon. Those 128 sold for a median of $3,062,500, 8% above the $2,845,000 median for all 351 detached sales.

blocks.text: Per square foot the flagged homes cost $821, 4% more than the $789 for all detached homes. They took 32 days to sell at a median, against 33, and closed at 92.9% of the last list price, against 93.0%. The export does not give floor area or lot size, so it cannot say how much of the price gap comes from bigger homes rather than the course.

125 of the 128 sales were flagged Golf Course Nearby, with a median of $3,075,000. Only 3 were flagged Golf Course Dev., in Eagle Harbour, Cypress Park Estates and the British Properties, so that group is too small to compare.
West Vancouver neighbourhoods with golf course homes

British Properties had the most flagged sales, 29, followed by Dundarave (12), Eagle Harbour (10) and Gleneagles (10). The top three areas together made up 40% of the 128 flagged sales, and 29 sub-areas had at least one.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a West Vancouver golf course home

items.t: Ask how close the lot is to the course and which side faces it. The flag showed on 128 West Vancouver sales, and a home flagged Golf Course Nearby can sit some distance from the course.
Look at the windows, siding and deck on the course side for ball marks, and ask the seller about damage, netting or an insurance claim.
Order the title. A right-of-way, covenant or setback can tie a lot to a course, and it shows on title, not on the listing.
Go at two different times of day. Mowing starts early and play changes the noise. The flagged homes took 32 days at a median, so there is time for a second visit.

Set the price against similar unflagged homes: $3,062,500 for the flagged group and $2,845,000 for all detached sales. West Vancouver prices vary a great deal by sub-area, so compare within the same area.
